svg.title: 03 - One run, start to finish
svg.desc: The eight orchestration steps (top) and the eight HTTP phases of the smoke profile (bottom).
svg.text: The eight orchestration steps (top) and the eight HTTP phases of the smoke profile (bottom).
SMOKE PROFILE - 8 phases, ~33 s total, peak C=20 (quick ~3.5 min / standard ~24 min share the same shape)
error-rate ceiling, OOM / restart, host free-RAM floor -> partial results are still written
comparison runs AFTER aggregation + grading; any exception becomes a warning in results.json
capture baseline CPU / anon memory so net values can be derived
warm the target, then step concurrency up instead of hammering cold
the only phase used for the throughput SLO (S4)
short burst to expose queueing and tail-latency blow-ups
zero load; S6 checks memory is actually released
S7 confirms the target still answers after the whole schedule
